literal_meaning: দিকের পালক বা রক্ষক (guardians of the directions)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই ব্যবসায়ী দিকপালের মতো প্রভাবশালী এই শহরে।
রাজনীতিতে তিনি একজন দিকপালের সমতুল্য অধিবলী ব্যক্তি।
example_sentences_in_english: That businessman is a Dikpala in this city, holding immense influence.
In politics, he is an influential figure akin to a Dikpala.
history: The term 'Dikpala' originates from Hindu mythology, referring to the eight guardian deities of the cardinal and ordinal directions, as described in ancient texts like the Puranas.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu cosmology, symbolizing supreme control over all directions, metaphorically extended to human influence.
